title: Fourth pillar of Islam – Zakah
intro: Zakah: a set share of wealth that a well-off Muslim must give.

learn.html: Besides the Shahadah, Salah and fasting, Allah gave the followers of Islam a fourth duty – ZAKAH. Zakah is giving a set part of one’s wealth by a person who is well off. It is commanded in the Qur’an and explained in detail in the hadiths of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW). Zakah was prescribed in the second year after the Hijrah.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah says: establish the prayer and give the zakah… <small>(Qur’an, Al-Baqarah 2:110)</small>

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet Muhammad (SAW) said: “Protect your wealth by giving zakah.” (Abu Dawud)
Every Muslim man and woman who is of sound mind, an adult, and owns wealth worth the nisab or more. The nisab is a set amount of wealth: whoever owns it counts as well off and must give zakah.

learn.text: Wealth on which zakah is given

learn.title: ⭐ Remember – Baytul-mal
learn.html: In Bosnia and Herzegovina, zakah, sadaqat al-fitr and other giving go to the Baytul-mal, a fund of the Islamic Community, and are shared out as the Qur’an commands. We give sadaqah on our own, but zakah in an organised way, through the community. In our community, the Imam can tell you how zakah is collected.
A person who must give zakah and does not, commits a great sin; whoever denies that zakah is a duty at all becomes an unbeliever.
